programme.title: The Haunting of...: Alysia Reiner

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Johnathan Schaech
programme.desc: Actor Johnathon Schaech (That Thing You Do!, Texas Rising) anxiously returns to an old theater in Austin, Texas where he had a harrowing and life-changing paranormal experience. With psychic medium Kim Russo by his side.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: Præsidentkandidaten
programme.desc: En mand slutter sig til den politiske kampagne for en snu kandidat til præsident i USA.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: I'm Not There' er en svimlende tur gennem Bob Dylans mytologiske verden og omskiftelige liv. Seks forskellige skuespillere spiller seks forskellige sider af Dylan i hans mest frugtbare årtier alt sammen set og hørt igennem Dylans udødelige tekster.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Teenagerne Eddie og Amber vokser op i en lille irsk by i løbet af 1990'erne. Alle har mistanke om at de er homoseksuelle, og hver dag er en kamp. De mødes og lader som om og indser at et opdigtet forhold kan være mindst lige så kompliceret som et rigtigt.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Den hurtigtsnakkende Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) har udset sig Newage-guruen dr. Sinja. Men efter et mystisk Bodhi-træ dukker op i hans have, indser Jack, at han hellere må forbedre sig, før det sidste blad falder af træet, ellers er han færdig.

programme.title: Cement i armen
programme.desc: Rulleskøjteløberen Rosco får et lift med lastbilchaufføren Mason, men de bliver stoppet af færdselspolitiet, som tror at de er to bankrøvere.

programme.title: Forår, sommer, efterår, vinter ... og forår
programme.desc: I en flydende eremitbolig midt i den koreanske vildmark guider en gammel munk en dreng gennem livets faser. Da drengen konfronteres med begær og vold, sættes hans visdom på prøve. En poetisk fortælling om balance, livscyklus og menneskelig indsigt.

programme.title: 24 Hours to Live
programme.desc: Travis Conrad, som er tidligere elitesoldat, er tynget af sorg over tabet af sin hustru og sin lille søn, da en tidligere soldaterkammerat, Jim Morrow, dukker op med et farligt og lukrativt jobtilbud.

programme.title: Setup

programme.title: Taken

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Carole Radziwill
programme.desc: Author, journalist and Real Housewife Carole Radziwill returns to the Hamptons, New York beach home where she once encountered a ghostly presence.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kesha
programme.desc: World famous singer-songwriter, Kesha revisits the Texas bed and breakfast where she encountered a paranormal apparition so tortured and disturbed it haunts her to this day.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: For at bevise sit værd risikerer en tidligere filmhelt alt. I sin kamp mod forskelige kritikere, et alter ego, sin datter og en skuespiller stræber han efter at komme ud af middelmådigheden.

programme.title: Legend: Director's Cut
programme.desc: I en eventyrskov med feer, nisser, enhjørninger ogdødelige bor også den mystiske skovbo, derer udset til at redde den smukke prinsesse ogbesejre mørkets onde fyrste…

programme.title: Mus I Eget Hus
programme.desc: De uheldige brødre Lars og Ernie Smuntz er ikke særligt imponerede over det faldefærdige, gamle herskabshus, de arver, indtil de opdager, at deres forfaldne ejendom faktisk er flere millioner værd.

programme.title: Face The Music
programme.desc: Dramakomedie med Molly Ringwald og Patrick Dempsey. Et fraskilt par, der engang skrev sange sammen, bliver hyret til at producere en sang til en ny film. Kan de lægge deres problemer til side og skabe et mesterværk?

programme.title: Asteroid
programme.desc: Sammen med sin kone og datter flytter en mand fra storbyen til sit drømmehus i udkanten af en lille by, fjern fra al kommunikation. Timingen kunne dog have været bedre, da det viser sig, at verden er ved at kollapse.

programme.title: Murder!
programme.desc: En nævning i en mordsag stemmer for at dømme, mens de andre nævninge tænker sig om og begynder at efterforske på egen hånd før henrettelsen.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley
programme.desc: Den rehabiliterede forbryder Jimmy Jayne er den hovedmistænkte i en brutal Hollywood-mordsag og vil gøre alt for at bevise sin uskyld.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: New Yorker-parret Josh og Cornelia er begge i 40’erne. Alderskrisen kradser, så da de møder et ungt hipster-par, Jamie og Darby, skiftes parmiddage ud med rulleskøjter, jazzhat og hip-hop-timer.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Mutant X: Tagelsen af krager
programme.desc: Da Lexa uden at vide det bliver bedøvet med et dødeligt stof, må holdet løbe om kap for at finde modgiften, før det er for sent.

programme.title: Mutant X: Mørkets skygger
programme.desc: Mutant X-holdet bliver tilkaldt for at undersøge bizarre aktiviteter, der finder sted på et lokalt hospital.

programme.title: Mutant X: Guds hånd
programme.desc: Mutant X-holdet begiver sig ud på en mission for at finde og fange en magtfuld supermutant, der har gudelignende kræfter.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ødemark
programme.desc: Jesse tvinges til at genoptage forbindelsen med sin tidligere forlovede, da Mutant X-holdet finder ud af, at hendes firma er involveret i genetisk manipulation af afgrøder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Heist
programme.desc: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.

programme.desc: Beavis og Butt-Head tager solbriller på og tror, de er VR-briller./ Beavis and Butt-Head bliiver låst ude og smadrer det i forsøget på at komme ind igen.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Holy Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head is really screwed when a visit to the hospital once again awakens The Great Cornoholio in Beavis. But two rooms over, the leader of a cult has died. Is the Great Cornholio destined to be the cult's idiot savior?

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: 1-900-BEAVIS / Water Safety
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to start their own phone service / Beavis and Butt-head learn CPR from Mr. Buzzcut

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Spirituel rejse
programme.desc: Beavis ser Jesus' ansigt i en nacho og det får ham til at ville besvare det store spørgsmål - "Hvorfor scorer jeg aldrig?"

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Tanning Booth Incident
programme.desc: Dangle learns that free tanning sessions for law enforcement aren't necessarily a good thing.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Strong Sister
programme.desc: Strong Sister magazine visits the station for an in-depth profile on Williams, and the deputies enforce Reno's six-foot rule for lap dances.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Dad Returns
programme.desc: While the deputies investigate Reno's Thai sex trade, Wiegel's long-lost father returns to reconnect with his daughter.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Junior Runs for Office
programme.desc: Junior finds a job he really wants: commissioner for animal carcass removal.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Acting Coach
programme.desc: Sergeant Clift, the LAPD's undercover acting coach, teaches the deputies the subtle art of theater.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Parade
programme.desc: The Carson City Parade Float Contest brings out the deputies' competitive spirit.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Training Day
programme.desc: Jones adjusts to his new partner's unorthodox style, and Wiegel and Williams enjoy some surprisingly delicious racist wines.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Extradition to Thailand!
programme.desc: Junior and Jones reap the benefits that come from extraditing a murderer, and Dangle and Rizzo receive a surprise crash course in surgery.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Digging with the Murderer
programme.desc: Dangle and Williams haggle with a serial killer to get him to reveal where he buried his victims.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Roasts Cops
programme.desc: Roastmester general Jeff Ross taler med Black Lives Matter-aktivister, kører en øjenåbnende tur med politiet og roaster folk fra Boston Politi.

programme.title: The Roast of Bob Saget
programme.desc: I hver udgave af "The Roast of" bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Den aggressivt venlige skuespiller fra "Hænderne Fulde" og "Sjov og spas".

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Day 1
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er David Spade og Kevin Hart.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programme.desc: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own
programme.desc: A playwright makes characters come to life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return
programme.desc: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris, og Justin Long serverer latter når unge servitører og servitriser søker etter meningen ved livet, kjærligheten, og vennskap i denne hysteriske komedien.

programme.title: How to Be
programme.desc: En annerledes ungdomskomedie om 25-åringen Art (Robert Pattinson fra Twilight) som blir dumpet av kjæresten sin, flytter tilbake til sine foreldre og får sin kvartlivs- krise.

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: the kids are all right Mødrene Nic & Jules hadde den perfekte familien... helt til de møtte mannen som gjorde det hele mulig.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Animasjonsfilm basert på en historie avnorskættede Roald Dahl. Herr og fru Rev leveret idyllisk liv, men herr Rev begynner å kjennepå sine dyriske instinkter.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: Meatballs
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller Tripper Harrison, sjefsveileder på Camp North Star. Det blir underholdende når han, og den skandaløse gjengen hans av leirveiledere, har det for seg å bryte alle regler i boka.

programme.title: Welcome to Collinwood
programme.desc: Cosimo får en plan for en kjempejobb av sin cellekamerat. Han ber kvinnen sin om å finne en patsy for tyveriet av bilen hans, og tilbyr 15 000 dollar. Plutselig er 7 involvert.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.desc: En huseier mistenker at den nye losjeren hennes er galningen som dreper kvinner i London.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekas onkel løper for kontoret i New Commonwealth, men et attentat får mannskapet til å opptre som hans sikkerhet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Into the Moonless Night
programme.desc: I den spennende sesongåpningen kommer de overlevende medlemmene av Mutant X ut av en dødelig eksplosjon for å møte Lexa, som får dem til å begynne å stille spørsmål ved grunnleggende antagelser om deres verden.

programme.title: Mutant X: Wages of Sin
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe auksjonen av et sterkt dødelig stoff som flere beryktede internasjonale terrorister kjemper om å skaffe seg.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Breed
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet blir hentet inn for å hjelpe en militærbase som har blitt smittet med en dødelig sykdom.

programme.title: Mutant X: Where Evil Dwell
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet må stoppe en seriemorder som etterlater ledetråder til sine neste ofre i form av gåter.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Candy Sale / To the Rescue
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head sell chocalate bars for their school. Well, the chocolate bars practically sell themselves. / Beavis and Butt-head witness a plane crash and appear in a cheesy reenactment on "Rescue 911."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Stewart is Missing / Yard Sale
programme.desc: Mrs. Stevenson shows up at Butt-head's house, desperate to enlist their help in finding Stewart. / Tom Anderson get Beavis and Butt-head to watch his yard sale, and the boys manage to sell everything when they take the sale inside.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Tainted Meat / Bad Dog
programme.desc: Beavis and his bacteria ridden "thingy" contaminate the food at Burger World. / Beavis and Butt-head adopt a vicious dog at a shelter and it trains them.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Crisis line / Career day
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A Very Special Episode / Dumbasses Anonymous
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head come to the aid of a wounded baby bird...almost. / Beavis and Butt-head show up at an AA meeting hoping to score some booze.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Nektet service / Balleskvis
programme.desc: Beavis prøver yogabukser og får dem ikke av. / Guttene oppdager at de har rett til å nekte service til kunder på Burger World.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: The Mystery of Morning Wood / U.S. History
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to stay awake all night, in an attempt to discover the secret behind morning wood. / For his oral report on an historical figure, Beavis recounts the valuable lessons he learned one night while eating at Burger World.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: En spirituell reise
programme.desc: Beavis ser ansiktet til Jesus i en nacho-chips. Det sender ham på en episk reise for å finne svar på det store spørsmålet - "Hvorfor får jeg aldri pult?"

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend
programme.desc: Dangle and the gang solve Reno's biggest mystery: who is Garcia's new girlfriend?

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Son
programme.desc: While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.

programme.title: RENO 911!: CSI: Reno
programme.desc: The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out
programme.desc: After a drug sting goes wrong, Dangle and Junior race back to the station on foot -- and naked.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married
programme.desc: Good news and bad news for Wiegel: her boyfriend proposed, but he's going to be executed for multiple murders.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Pregnant
programme.desc: Did Dangle and Garcia freeze to death? Did Wiegel's serial killer husband get lethally injected? What is Carrot Top doing in Reno, and why is he so mad?

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Junior Bros.
programme.desc: While Garcia goes undercover to bust undocumented workers and the people who hire them, Junior spends his day off with his brothers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jet Ski Blues
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Rick's On It
programme.desc: Rick the Citizens' Patrolman one-ups the Sheriff's Department in investigating a crime spree, and Garcia receives a visit from an old, unpredictable friend.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programme.desc: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Odyssey of Flight 33
programme.desc: Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programme.desc: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Florida Project
programme.desc: Seks år gamle Moonee og hennes mor som bor på et budsjettmotell utenfor Disney World i Florida.

programme.title: Fisherman's Friends
programme.desc: I idylliske Port Isaac hører Danny tilfeldigvis koret Fisherman's Friends, bestående av ti ekte fiskere. Danny jobber for et plateselskap, og bestemmer seg for å signere koret, men å signere ti røffe fiskere viser seg å være lettere sagt en gjort.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: Den "svarte får"-sønnen av en velstående familie møter en ung psykiatrisk pasient som har vokst opp i isolasjon hele sitt liv. Han tar med seg denne naive unge kvinnen hjem til brorens bryllup.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden rakner når to lekre menn plutselig dukker opp: en sexy, ny klassekamerat og den søte eks-stebroren hennes. Nå oppdager hun at når det kommer til kjærlighet, er hun totalt uvitende.

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tenåringene Eddie og Amber vokste opp i en liten irsk småby på 1990-tallet. Alle mistenker at de er homofile, og hver dag er en kamp. De kommer sammen på late som og innser at et imaginært forhold kan være minst like komplisert som et ekte

programme.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Them
programme.desc: Engang var Conor og Eleanor lykkelig gift. Nå føler de seg fremmed for hverandre, og i kjølevannet av en tragisk hendelse lengter de etter å finne tilbake til det liv og den kjærligheten de engang hadde.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen er en amerikansk racersjåfør i 24-TIMERSLØPET PÅ LE MANS i denne heseblesende originalfilmen, som er filmet på Le Mans-banen, med bilstunt som gir deg hakeslepp og action som får hjertet til å banke.

programme.title: Murder!
programme.desc: En jurymedlem i en mordrettssak stemmer for å dømme, mens de andre jurymedlemmene har andre tanker og begynner å etterforske på egenhånd før henrettelsen.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Wages of Sydney
programme.desc: Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 f.Kr.: Kineserne oppfinner et eksplosivt gaveegg. New York, 2001: En rival slår Sydney og Nigel til et kart som fører til Dragon's Egg.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Vampire's Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, en babymagnet, professor og romanforfatter, ber Sydney hjelpe til med å finne Vlad Tepes 'tapte relikvie. Og han er ikke den eneste etter det.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney støter på eksen Gray og drar på ferie med ham til Bali, men når Derek Lloyd dukker opp for å verve henne til å finne Parvati's Bowl, kan hun ikke motstå.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydneys samboer fra skolen er på sporet med et anheng fra fortiden hennes og verver Sydney for å hjelpe til med å finne den og fange morderen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensomme og jevne sanden
programme.desc: Når Andromeda blir angrepet av rompirater, blir de reddet av et langt mistet romskip fra jorden.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Spanish Mike Comes Back
programme.desc: Spanish Mike Alvarez returns to tempt the deputies, and Jones and Garcia work security at a Ted Nugent concert.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Son of a Chechekevitch
programme.desc: The deputies vow to avenge Sheriff Chechekevitch's death, and Wiegel studies with Lamaze instructor Guy Gerricault.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Investigation Continues
programme.desc: The investigation into Sheriff Chechekevitch's murder zeroes in on his ex-wife, and Williams and Wiegel attend a Lamaze class.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Corporate Sponsor
programme.desc: Hotty's Restaurants sponsors the Reno Sheriff's Department, and the gang gets burned by the deal.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Christian Karaoke Singles' Mixer
programme.desc: Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Proposition C
programme.desc: As Williams and Wiegel consider tampering with the vote for deputies' raises, Jones and Garcia tangle with a drug dealer who may be a D.E.A. agent.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Reno Mounties
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia discover that not just anyone can dispense justice from horseback.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Hodgepodge
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department takes more than seven hours to respond to a liquor store robbery.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Happy Anniversary
programme.desc: Dangle visits his ex-wife and her new husband on their anniversary, and the lady deputies stake out a lecherous meth dealer and his girlfriends.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Hocus-Pocus and Frisby
programme.desc: A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programme.desc: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Old Man in the Cave
programme.desc: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programme.desc: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Penny For Your Thoughts
programme.desc: Gaining telepathic abilities when his coin lands on its edge bank clerk Hector B. Poole learns about the difference between other people's plans and fantasies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mind and the Matter
programme.desc: Using the power of mind over matter, Archibald Beechcroft remakes the world to his own specifications.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Masks
programme.desc: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: It's a Good Life
programme.desc: Little Anthony Fremont controls an entire town with his ability to read minds and make people do as he wishes.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: Philomena
programme.desc: En livstrett politisk journalist tar opp historien om en kvinnes leting etter sønnen. Han ble tatt fra henne for tiår siden da hun ble gravid og ble tvunget til å leve i et kloster.

programme.title: Cat's Meow
programme.desc: I 1924 samlet mediemogulen William Randolph Hearst noen av verdens best kjente personligheter for en tur på yachten sin som resulterte i et uløst og neddysset drap.

programme.title: Presidentkandidaten
programme.desc: En mann blir med i den politiske kampanjen til en sleip presidentkandidat i USA.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: Tully er regissert av Jason Reitman og manuset skrevet av Diablo Cody, duoen som tidligere har laget Juno og Young Adults.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: 16-år gamle Megan Walsh er i trening for å bli en iskald internasjonal leiemorder, men i hemmelighet lengter hun etter å være en normal tenåring. Hun forfalsker derfor sin egen død.

En kreftpasient (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) overvinner alle odds med hjelp av sin beste venn (Seth Rogen), sin mor (Anjelica Huston) og en ung terapeut (Anna Kendrick).

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nesten tjue år etter at kult-serien Galaxy Quest ble kansellert, ber romvesener besetningen om hjelp til å redde universet.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlegger finner kjærligheten mens hun jobber med å arrangere det siste bryllupet på en historisk taverna.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: Incendies
programme.desc: När notarien Lebel ska läsa upp Nawals testamente för hennes barn Jeanne och Simon, upptäcker de två kuvert: ett till den far de trodde var död, och ett till en bror som de inte visste om.

programme.title: Poupelle of Chimney Town
programme.desc: Poupelle från Chimney Town är berättelsen om den unge Lubicchi som lever bland denU+000Atjocka röken från skorstenarna i sin isolerade stad och längtar efter att se “stjärnorna” veta sanningen som hans far alltid berättat om för honom

programme.title: Pluto TV Komedi
programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unga journalisten Tamara Drewe återvänder till sina rötter på den engelska landsbygden för att sälja sitt barndomshem efter att hennes mamma dött.

programme.title: Captain Fantastic
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen medverkar i denna gripande och roliga berättelse om en pappa med en annorlunda inställning till föräldraskapet som blir tvungen att visa den moderna världen för barnen.

programme.title: The Mega
programme.desc: Militären har skickat ned att team i Stilla havet. Plötsligt står de öga mot öga med en haj som mänskligheten aldrig tidigare skådat. Den attackerar och de måste bekämpa den monstruösa besten.

programme.title: Trinity klipper till igen
programme.desc: Västerns värsta vildhjärnor rider tillsammans igen och då blir västern verkligen vild. De är bröderna som din mamma varnade dig för. Och din doktor! Och alla begravningsbyråer! Och framförallt läkarna som måste ta hand om alla som skrattat käkarna ur led!

programme.title: Mutant X: Nar för Kärlek
programme.desc: Shalimar blir nära en annan vilde när det är "lust vid första ögonkastet", men saker och ting blir komplicerade när hennes nya pojkvän försöker hitta ett botemedel för sin sjukdom.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Buddhas skål
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel åker till Nepal för att hämta Buddhas mytomspunna överfyllda allmoseskål till byborna som håller på att bygga en helgedom till den ursprungliga Buddha.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: Våra värsta år: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Al gets heated up over the large phone bill and refuses to pay it. This results in the disconnection of the Bundy phone line and making him the target of hostility from Peggy, the kids and the Rhodes who now take the Bundys phone calls on their phone.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 1
programme.desc: While Al and Steve are occupied by a female employee who fixes the Bundy's refrigerator, Peggy invites Marcy to a strip club with the girls.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun - Pt 2
programme.desc: Marcy loses her composure and wedding ring when it slips into a dancer's briefs while slipping him a tip. Desperate to keep the news from Steve, Marcy sets out to distract him every chance she gets.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Woodshop / T.V. Violence / Canned / Garage band
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head take woodworking class / Stevensons get a sattelite dish / An unopened can puts our duo to new adventures / Beavis and Butt-Head form a band called Metallica

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Buy Beer / Just For Girls
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head get drunk off non-alcoholic beer and fail a sobriety test. / Beavis and Butt-head are allowed to watch a film for girls about teen pregnancy. The titillation ends abruptly during the birthing sequence.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Corporate Sponsor
programme.desc: Hotty's Restaurants sponsors the Reno Sheriff's Department, and the gang gets burned by the deal.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Christian Karaoke Singles' Mixer
programme.desc: Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Dummy
programme.desc: A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: 100 Yards over the Rim
programme.desc: A pioneer from a wagon train in 1847 sets off to find something for his ill son and stumbles into present-day New Mexico.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
programme.desc: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Back There
programme.desc: At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Little People
programme.desc: An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programme.desc: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
programme.desc: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: Donovan'S Reef
programme.desc: The Duke, Lee Marvin and Jack Warden play navy buddies that made the French Polynesian island of Haleakaloha their post-war paradise. Local headquarters is Donovan's Reef, Wayne's watering hole.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Ett kapat flygplan kommer att krascha om bara 97 minuter när bränslet tar slut. NSA-chefen vill att planet ska skjutas ner innan dess och lämnar de oskyldiga passagerarnas öde i händerna på en hemlig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: När tre banditer tar en framstående läkare i staden som gisslan på jakt efter en försvunnen kvinna kallas sheriff Watts in för att hantera situationen innan FBI anländer.

programme.title: Miami Supercops
programme.desc: Här kommer ännu en actionspäckad komedi från den dynamiska duon Hill och Spencer. I "Miami Supercops" ser vi våra hjältar jaga både brottslingar och 20 miljoner dollar som stals vid ett rån för ett par år sedan.

programme.title: Wagons East
programme.desc: De sökte guld men nöjer sig nu med rinnande vatten i huset. John Candy och Richard Lewis har huvudrollerna i denna dråpliga, okonventionella titt på den gamla Västern.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Rökande pistol
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel letar efter Al Capones diamantbeströdda pistol på uppdrag av en man som hoppas att den ska rentvå hans farfar för ett mord han var inramad för.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Den huvudlösa nunnan
programme.desc: När Sydneys plan kraschar får hon i uppdrag av en grupp nunnor att hitta huvudet på en annan nunna som halshöggs för flera århundraden sedan.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dubbel hjelix
programme.desc: Andromeda blir inblandad i en fejd mellan en Than-planet och en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ängel mörk, demon ljus
programme.desc: En slipstream skickar Andromeda tillbaka i tiden till strax innan Samväldet faller. Besättningen måste ingripa för att bevara historien.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipsarna som förblindar
programme.desc: När besättningen svarar på ett nödsamtal hämtar de Bekas bror, som nu är Wayist, och hans vän.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Born to Walk
programme.desc: Al flunks his written drivers test the same day that Kelly passes hers, leading him confined to the house and unable to get to the racetrack to bet on an important horse race.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Alley of the Dolls
programme.desc: Victory seems assured when Steve agrees to join the Bundys for a family team bowling match against Peggy's arch rival from high school, Mimi, and her obnoxious family.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Razor's Edge
programme.desc: Steve returns home having grown a beard from a week-long rafting trip. He and Marcy get into a huge argument over his reluctance to shave it off, leading him to move in with the Bundys.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: How do You Spell Revenge?
programme.desc: Al, Peggy and Bud are part of a shopping mall softball team playing other mall teams. After losing a few too many games, Al demands that Peggy improve her softball skills or she is off his team.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Earth Angel
programme.desc: There's a new light in the neighborhood when Bud brings home an attractive, free spirited, 21-year-old artist named Tiffany on her way to art school in New York. Everyone likes her, except Marcy, who thinks Tiffany steals the attentions of Steve.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: You Better Watch Out
programme.desc: The Bundys' Christmas is rudely interrupted when a parachuting mall Santa crash-lands into their backyard, attracting the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: When starting a baseball card collection, Al and Steve sell Marcy's old Barbie doll. They must get it back, but learn that the shop they sold it to was robbed.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Build a Better Mousetrap
programme.desc: Al's attempts to get rid of a rodent in the Bundy house end badly.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Master the Possibilities
programme.desc: Al, under the impression that you don't have to pay for anything you didn't order, takes Peggy and Bud on a wild spending spree when the mailman accidentally leaves a new credit card addressed to Buck the dog.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Nose Bleed / Vaya Con Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head tries some sadistic home remedies in an attempt to stop Beavis's nosebleed. / When Beavis turns into Cornholio in Burger World, Immigration Officials take him in as a possible illegal alien and try to make sense of his gibberish.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Meet God
programme.desc: Innocent, naive yougsters Beavis & Butt-head are drawn into an insidious religious cult.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Shortcuts / Late Night with Butt-Head / Butt, Butt Hike!
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head miss the schoolbus home / The duo makes a Late Night Show / Beavis and Butt-Head are invited to play football

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Shopping cart / Die Fly, Die! / Drinking Butt-ies
programme.desc: Our duo find out that accidents can lead to money / Beavis and Butt-Head get annoyed at a fly / After a beating by Todd, they become best friends over beer

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Pool Toys / Beavis & Butt-Head's Island
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head help Mr. Anderson build an in-ground swimming pool. / "Beavis and Butt-head get stranded on their own island, while in search of cool chicks, like Ginger.BALL BREAKERS: Just how DO you crack open a bowling ball?"

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Två korkade män / En konstig fredag
programme.desc: Medelålders Beavis och Butt-Head tar sitt ansvar som jurymedlemmar./ Beavis och Butt-Head får för sig att de har bytt kroppar.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Den nya fienden / Dubbelgångaren
programme.desc: Tvättbjörnar stjäl Beavis och Butt-Heads nachos,och pojkarna slår tillbaka./ Beavis misstar en främling för Butthead, och blir sen inte av med honom.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Den farligaste leken / Benjägarna
programme.desc: För att hindra varandra från att stoppa händerna i varmt vatten och kissa på sig håller sg grabbarna vakna i flera dagar./ Beavis och Butt-Head bygger ett dinosaurieskelett av ben från en grillmiddag.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Holy Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head is really screwed when a visit to the hospital once again awakens The Great Cornoholio in Beavis. But two rooms over, the leader of a cult has died. Is the Great Cornholio destined to be the cult's idiot savior?

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: 1-900-BEAVIS / Water Safety
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to start their own phone service / Beavis and Butt-head learn CPR from Mr. Buzzcut

programme.title: RENO 911!: Proposition C
programme.desc: As Williams and Wiegel consider tampering with the vote for deputies' raises, Jones and Garcia tangle with a drug dealer who may be a D.E.A. agent.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Reno Mounties
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia discover that not just anyone can dispense justice from horseback.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Hodgepodge
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department takes more than seven hours to respond to a liquor store robbery.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Happy Anniversary
programme.desc: Dangle visits his ex-wife and her new husband on their anniversary, and the lady deputies stake out a lecherous meth dealer and his girlfriends.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wedding
programme.desc: Dangle preps for his wedding after his ex-wife's ex-husband proposes, and Wiegel goes into labor while stuck in cake.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jumping the Shark
programme.desc: Garcia breaks up Dangle's wedding in more ways than one, and Terry the prostitute finds someone to love.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Tommy Hawk
programme.desc: Tommy Hawk, bounty hunter, and reality TV star runs afoul of the Reno Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Kevlar for Her
programme.desc: The department's new bulletproof vests for women have an unexpected side effect: super knockers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Mayor Hernandez
programme.desc: Reno's Mayor Hernandez asks the Sheriff's Department for help, and the deputies must decide whether to uphold the law or uphold local government.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
programme.desc: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programme.desc: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun
programme.desc: The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programme.desc: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead
programme.desc: Donald bor sedan 17 år i ett självbyggt kyffe i parken Hampstead Heath i London. När det ska byggas lyxbostäder där han bor vägrar han att flytta. Han får då oväntad hjälp av den amerikanska änkan Emily och en djup vänskap uppstår mellan dem.

programme.title: Mustang
programme.desc: Vad fem tonårssystrar ser som en oskyldig lek med några killar tolkas av andra i byn som osedlighet. Historien växer till oanade proportioner och snart börjar systrarnas frihet kringskäras allt mer. Men upproret bubblar under ytan hos systerskaran.

programme.title: I morgon börjar allt
programme.desc: Samuel, en man vars bekymmerslösa liv på Franska Rivieran vänds upp och ner när Kristin, som han haft en kortare romans med, plötsligt dyker upp och presenterar honom för deras nyfödda dotter Gloria. Kristin överlämnar Gloria med varm hand i hans vårdnad.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: Med scener som aldrig skulle visas i TV! Stollarna från MTV-serien "Jackass" är tillbaka med stuntsm som ingen skulle låta dem göra i TV.

programme.title: Bronson
programme.desc: Charles Bronson, född Michael Peterson, är Englands mest våldsbenägne intern. Redan som barn drömde han om att bli berömd, men visste inte för vad tills den dagen han rånade ett postkontor.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: Den otroliga men sanna historien om tre polska bröder som under andra världskriget gjorde motstånd mot den massiva tyska ockupationsmakten, något som räddade tusentals människor.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Storfräsarna
programme.desc: Terence Hill och Bud Spencer får dubbelgångare. Tur att två av dem kan slåss! De rika kusinerna Antonio och Sebastiano är två brasilianska mångmiljonärer som lever i skräck för yrkesmördare. Därför anställer de två dubbelgångare.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bankerna i Lethe
programme.desc: Ett svart hål gör det möjligt för Dylan att kommunicera med sin före detta fästmö, 300 år tillbaka i tiden.

programme.title: Mutant X: Kilohertz
programme.desc: En ny mutant kidnappas från sin familj, och Mutant X ger sig ut för att hämta honom och ta reda på varför Eckhart är intresserad av honom.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dödens mening
programme.desc: När en pest som bara drabbar mutanter härjar, går Adam och Eckhart med på att samarbeta för att hitta ett botemedel.

programme.title: Mutant X: Tänd säkring
programme.desc: Eckhart söker en mutant som kan absorbera energi, en mutant som Brennan blir romantiskt involverad med.

programme.title: Mutant X: I närvaro av mina fiender
programme.desc: Jesse blir förälskad i en datorhacker som Eckhart vill "skaffa" för att korrumpera de offentliga nyhetskanalerna mot de nya mutanterna... och till GSA:s fördel.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Blonde and Blonder
programme.desc: On Valentines Day, Kelly hauls in a load of Valentines, while Steve plans to give Marcy a trip to Hawaii. When Marcy finds out from Peggy, she plans to give Steve his Valentine present by jumping out of a life-size cake.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Great Escape
programme.desc: The Bundy's stay at the shoe store after their house is tented for termites. A grounded Kelly plots to escape and go to a rock concert.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Impo-Dent
programme.desc: Marcy regrets denting Steve's new car when he claims that she's made him impotent.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Just Married…with Children
programme.desc: While secretly going through Steve and Marcy's mail, Al and Peggy fill out an application to a TV game show called "How Do I Love Thee" where the objective is a Bundy natural: surviving physical torture from one's spouse.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Father Lode
programme.desc: After going with Steve to the racetrack, Al is reluctant to reveal that he won $1,200, because he knows that Peggy and the kids will take the money for themselves.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: All in the Family
programme.desc: Al's quiet three-day weekend plans to watch his favorite John Wayne movie "Hondo" are ruined when Peggy's eccentric relatives come to visit the Bundy household.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Camping Show (aka A Period Piece)
programme.desc: Steve, Marcy and the Bundys head out to Steve and Marcy's cabin in the woods, but the merriment is halted by Kelly's PMS. The men leave for a bit to go out fishing, and return to all three women menstruating and hostile.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: He Thought He Could
programme.desc: Al discovers a library book that was due in 1957. He must return it to the library and face up to his worst childhood fear: the librarian.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: I'm Going to Sweatland
programme.desc: When a perspiration stain on one of Al's shirts resembles a silhouette of The King of Rock & Roll, the Bundy household becomes a hot spot for Elvis Presley fanatics to visit.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Instängda / Biodlarna
programme.desc: Beavis och Butt-Head fastnar i en pappkartong när de försöker gömma sig i skolan./ Beavis och Butt-Head försöker skörda honung från ett getingbo.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Stewart is Missing / Yard Sale
programme.desc: Mrs. Stevenson shows up at Butt-head's house, desperate to enlist their help in finding Stewart. / Tom Anderson get Beavis and Butt-head to watch his yard sale, and the boys manage to sell everything when they take the sale inside.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Ding-Dong-Ditch / Head lice / Nothing happening
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head have trouble with a prank / The duo try to cure their scratchy heads / A quiet day in Highland, Texas

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Manners Suck / Pipe Of Doom
programme.desc: Mr. Van Driessen gives his class a lesson in manners that no one will ever forget. He punches out the etiquette teacher. / Butt-head gets stuck in a construction site pipe, a la Baby Jessica.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Work is Death (aka Burger World) / Werewolves of Highland / Tech Support
programme.desc: After the Manager explains that Workers Compensation pays you for getting injured on the job, Butt-head sets out to injure Beavis / A Vampire craze hits the high school / Beavis and Butt-Head misinterpret what it means to ask a man for his daughter's hand

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Leave it to Beavis/ Butt Flambé / Crying / Doomsday
programme.desc: The show parodies Leave It to Beaver / The duo needs to go to a hospital / Beavis cries and is mocked unrelentlessly / Highland experiences a toxic gas leak

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: The Crush / Young, Gifted & Crude
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head want to hang with a "really cool' bunch of delinquents. / Beavis & Butt-head spend some time with the school's gifted class. Not much time.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: The Mystery of Morning Wood / U.S. History
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to stay awake all night, in an attempt to discover the secret behind morning wood. / For his oral report on an historical figure, Beavis recounts the valuable lessons he learned one night while eating at Burger World.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Coconut Nut Clusters
programme.desc: The deputies raise money selling delicious Coconut Nut Clusters door-to-door.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Back in Black
programme.desc: Dangle reconnects with his family after his estranged father passes away.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover at Burger Cousin
programme.desc: Rick the Burger Cousin manager is a cruel taskmaster when deputies go undercover flipping burgers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Wall
programme.desc: Garcia and Junior help build a wall to keep Mexicans from crossing into America illegally.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Death of a Pickle-Thrower
programme.desc: Jackie, the pickle-throwing hooker, spends her twilight hours with the Reno Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Baghdad 911
programme.desc: Iraqi police force cadets learn law enforcement skills from Reno's finest, and Dangle and Wiegel destroy a huge cocaine supply.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Tanning Booth Incident
programme.desc: Dangle learns that free tanning sessions for law enforcement aren't necessarily a good thing.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Strong Sister
programme.desc: Strong Sister magazine visits the station for an in-depth profile on Williams, and the deputies enforce Reno's six-foot rule for lap dances.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Dad Returns
programme.desc: While the deputies investigate Reno's Thai sex trade, Wiegel's long-lost father returns to reconnect with his daughter.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
programme.desc: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy
programme.desc: When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Penny For Your Thoughts
programme.desc: Gaining telepathic abilities when his coin lands on its edge bank clerk Hector B. Poole learns about the difference between other people's plans and fantasies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Howling Man
programme.desc: Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
programme.desc: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nothing in the Dark
programme.desc: A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
programme.desc: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Bageriet på Portobello Road
programme.desc: Tre generationer kvinnor som måste övervinna sorg, tvivel och hur de ska hedra deras älskade Sarahs minne samtidigt som de börjar ett äventyr att etablera ett bageri mitt i London som är fylld av kärlek, hopp och färgstarka bakverk från hela världen.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: Emma sitter på ett plan som hon tror är på väg att störta. Hon berättar därför alla sina hemligheter för en snygg främling. Åtminstone tror hon att han är en främling...tills hon träffar Jack, hennes företags nya vd. Baserad på romanen med samma namn.

programme.title: A Breath Of Scandal
programme.desc: Den vackra Sophia Loren är den österrikiska prinsessan som, trots sin exil från familjegården, föraktar sin mors önskan att gifta sig med en prins.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Disaster movie' följer de komiska missödena av några sjukt snygga 20-åringar under en ödesdiger natt då de försöker att komma i säkerhet undan alla naturkatastrofer som finns.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den före detta CIA-agenten Robert lever i ett hemligt sällskap för pensionerade spioner. Nu är hans son Paul i knipa och behöver hans hjälp - men Pauls planer är inte alls lika hemliga som hans fars liv.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Robert ger sig ut på ett djärvt räddningsuppdrag för att frita Sasha, änkan till hans gamle ärkefiende. Men väl tillbaka i ledningsbunkern verkar Sasha ha egna svekfulla planer.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Filmen berättar historien om Travis, en man vilse i sitt eget privata helvete. Förmodad död i fyra år, dyker han en dag upp i öknen, trött och med minnesförlust.

programme.title: Dom kallar meg Trinity - Djävulens högra hand
programme.desc: Han har en käft lika väloljad som hans revolver. Han säger att han är en fredens man - men vem vågar tro honom? Hans namn är Trinity - Djävulens högra hand.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Tack så mycket
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel åker till Tyskland för att hitta en förlorad Elvis Presley-gitarr.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Diamant i det grova
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och den rivaliserande reliktjägaren Kurt Reiner försöker hitta Jimmy Jonesboros försvunna basebollhandske.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Förvandling
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Derek Lloyd beger sig till den peruanska djungeln för att leta efter Paracelsus-rullarna som innehåller formeln för att förvandla bly till guld.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Etsad i sten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Stewie Harper åker till Stockholm i Sverige för att hitta runstenen från kung Jann I av Norge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.desc: Brad Stine is the most media-covered Christian comedian in the country. He had an 8-page profile written about him and his comedy in the New Yorker magazine where he was referred to as Gods Comic.Brad was a regular live social commentator on Fox & Friends every Monday morning for six months.He has been featured in the New York Times, Christian Science Monitor, Los Angeles Times, Wall Street Journal, and USA Today. He has had material published in Readers Digest and Focus on the Family magazine.He has five original DVDs featuring his comedy, and has written two books, Live from Middle America Rants from a Red-State Comedian, published by Hudson Street Press and Being a Christian Without Being an IdiotHe has appeared in numerous films including Poodle Springs on HBO, Welcome to Paradise, Sarahs Choice, Christmas With a Capital C, and Covering Your Tracts. programme.title: Bone Hampton
programme.desc: As down home as collards and cornbread, as sharp as a pickaxe, and as funny as a possum in a petticoat, Comedian Bone Hampton is a master at making audiences feel like family. His clean, homespun humor, sharp wit, and easy delivery makes the Dove Award-winning "Comedian of the Year" one of the most highly sought after performers in the business. With more than 20 years in the game, his résumé is ever expanding with impressive stage and TV credits. The Texas native has logged countless appearances on ABC's "The View," including two stints as Guest Co-Host, and has served as personal gag writer for Actress/Comedienne Sherri Shepherd since 2010. He's also appeared on ABC's "Less Than Perfect," NBC's "My Name is Earl," BET's "Comic View," and the syndicated talk show Comics Unleashed with host Byron Allen. And yes, that is Bone in the very funny national commercial for Church's Chicken. No stranger to the big screen, Bone has appeared alongside Hollywood juggernaut Sandra Bullock in the romantic comedy "All About Steve," and can be seen in the film "Woodlawn" starring Sean Austin and Oscar winner Jon Voight. Bone took a leap of faith and moved to Los Angeles to pursue comedy full-time. Nothing could have prepared him for the culture shock that greeted him. Next to the hardcore acts he shared the stage with, his family-friendly routine seemed soft. But that fish-out-of-water experience inspired him to remain true to himself and to his God—no matter where he performed. He set out to carve out a niche all his own. (And carve he did!) In 2005, the Urban Gospel Alliance named him “Comedian of the Year.” His mission was simple—“I just like to have a good time. I just want to be the ringleader of the good time,” Bone says. Ask anyone who's ever seen Bone Hampton perform, they will tell you: Mission accomplished. Bone can be heard all day long on satellite radio, and caught on TV anytime your television is on.
